entries.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence

entries.title: Reimagining advertising with AI
entries.summary: Explore new AI-powered advertising experiences from OpenAI, including Sponsored Agents, tools for marketers, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.

entries.title: Hex turns complex analysis into visual reports with GPT‑6 Astra
entries.summary: GPT-6 Astra helps Hex’s data agents turn answers into interactive visualizations that employees are proud to share.

entries.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment

entries.summary: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.
